paragraphs.chinese:
这一集讲的是 Luke 的生日。Phil 和 Claire 下定决心，这次绝对不能再把他的生日搞砸。Luke 的生日总是撞上感恩节前后，而且他平时也不怎么开口要东西，所以今年他们想给他办一场真正能记住的生日派对。

Claire 准备了一个手工区，让孩子们做皮革梳子套。Phil 一听就觉得无聊得要命，于是背着她弄来攀岩墙、滑索、充气城堡，还有一堆大型游乐设施。Jay 这边更离谱，直接送了 Luke 一把弩——这显然是最不该送给 Luke 的东西之一。

Cameron 则打扮成 Fizbo 来参加派对，这是他年轻时创造的一个小丑角色。Mitchell 觉得这身打扮很丢人，而 Phil 其实非常怕小丑。不过去派对的路上，Fizbo 意外证明了自己还挺有用。一个粗鲁的司机开车蹭到 Mitchell，却死活不肯道歉。Cameron 穿着全套小丑服下车，硬是把那个人吓到认错。Mitchell 也不得不承认，Fizbo 有时候确实挺管用。

Manny 一直忙着讨好学校里的一个女孩 Bianca。Jay 告诉他，女生喜欢幽默的男生，于是 Manny 连着讲了几个笑话，结果全都冷场。Gloria 让他别再使劲表现，做回那个甜甜的自己就行。Manny 把这也当成了一套新策略，不过等派对彻底失控之后，他反而得到了一次更好的表现机会。

真正的大乱子是从 Haley 开始的。Dylan 整场派对都在和 Jungle Tanya 聊个不停，Tanya 就是那个负责带爬行动物和昆虫来的女人。Haley 一开始装作无所谓，可 Alex 一直在旁边提醒她 Dylan 看起来有多投入。Haley 越来越吃醋，最后故意把 Tanya 的一个箱子弄开，让里面的东西跑了出来。她当时并不知道，跑出来的是一只毒蝎子。

蝎子一跑掉，整个派对立刻开始崩盘。Fizbo 看见它之后吓得乱跑，把 Claire 的手工桌撞翻，珠子撒得到处都是。Phil 为了躲小丑往后退，又撞到 Jay，Jay 手里的弩直接射中了充气城堡。城堡开始塌，而 Bianca 还在里面，于是 Manny 冲进去救她。Bianca 出来以后又说自己的狗还没出来，Manny 只好再次冲进去——最后才发现她说的是一只气球狗。

就在这片混乱里，Luke 踩到 Claire 手工桌上散出来的珠子，摔断了胳膊。Phil 搞来了那么多看起来危险的东西，最后真正把 Luke 送进医院的，反而是 Claire 那个最安静、最“安全”的手工项目。

Phil 和 Claire 都觉得愧疚得不行，Luke 却高兴坏了。他一直想要一个石膏，现在全家都围在旁边给他签名，他直接宣布这是自己过过最棒的生日。

Haley 对自己怎么处理 Tanya 这件事还挺得意。然后，那只失踪的蝎子最后出现在了她自己的房间里。
paragraphs.english:
This episode is about Luke’s birthday, which Phil and Claire are determined not to mess up. His birthday always gets lost around Thanksgiving, and Luke never asks for much, so this year they decide to give him a party he’ll actually remember.

Claire plans an arts-and-crafts table where the kids can make leather holders for their combs. Phil thinks that sounds painfully boring, so without telling her, he brings in a rock-climbing wall, a zip line, a bouncy castle, and other big attractions. Jay, meanwhile, gives Luke a crossbow, which is exactly the kind of gift Luke probably shouldn’t have.

Cameron shows up as Fizbo, the clown character he created when he was younger. Mitchell thinks the whole thing is embarrassing, and Phil is secretly terrified of clowns. On the way to the party, though, Fizbo proves surprisingly useful. A rude driver bumps Mitchell with his car and refuses to apologize, so Cameron gets out in full clown costume and scares the guy into saying sorry. Mitchell has to admit that Fizbo has his moments.

Manny is busy trying to impress a girl from school named Bianca. Jay tells him girls like funny guys, so Manny tries a few jokes and completely bombs. Gloria tells him to stop trying so hard and just be his sweet self. Manny takes that as a new strategy, but when the party later falls apart, he gets a much better chance to impress her.

The real trouble starts with Haley. Dylan spends most of the party talking to Jungle Tanya, the woman handling the reptiles and insects. Haley pretends not to care at first, but Alex keeps pointing out how interested Dylan looks. Haley gets jealous and deliberately lets one of Tanya’s creatures out, without realizing it’s a poisonous scorpion.

Once the scorpion is loose, everything goes wrong fast. Fizbo sees it and runs through the party in a panic, knocking over Claire’s craft table and sending beads everywhere. Phil backs away from the clown and bumps into Jay, whose crossbow fires into the bouncy castle. The castle starts collapsing with Bianca inside, so Manny rushes in to save her. When Bianca says her dog is still inside, he goes back for that too—only to discover she means a balloon dog.

In the middle of all this, Luke slips on the beads from Claire’s craft table and breaks his arm. After all the dangerous things Phil brought to the party, it’s Claire’s harmless little craft project that actually sends Luke to the hospital.

Phil and Claire feel awful, but Luke is thrilled. He’s always wanted a cast, everyone is there to sign it, and he calls it the best birthday he’s ever had.

Haley still acts pretty proud of how she handled Tanya. Then the missing scorpion turns up in her own room.
